objectives:
This course introduces the students to the “economic constitution” of the modern world. Here you’ll learn:

- the regulatory structure of contemporary competition law,
- main legal doctrines therein, and
- major challenges brought by newest developments in technologies, business methods and so on.
content:
Market Definition ＆ Market Power
Restraints of Trade
Exclusionary Practices
Merger Control
Unfair Competition
books:
王立達，競爭法新視野：關鍵反省及與智慧財產權之交錯 (2022)。
胡祖舜，《競爭法之經濟分析》（2019）。
公平會，《認識公平交易法》(最新版)。
Others: TBA.
